fix.value: Presented in the Chamber of Deputies before 1 May 2025 and sent to its advisory committees for opinions before plenary consideration. The Committee on Social Equity and Equal Rights of Men and Women, chaired by Deputy Rocío Abed, convened a public hearing on the bill with experts and the public for 4 June 2025 in the Bicameral Hall of the National Congress. The bill gives priority to human rights, sustainability and inclusion in promoting AI. A separate Senate bill regulating AI systems, presented in May 2025, is PY-01.

evidence.quote: El evento se realizará el miércoles 4 de junio, a partir de las 10:00, en la Sala Bicameral del Congreso Nacional.

summary_claims.claim: Explanatory statement calls for a comprehensive framework / state policy on AI combining innovation with ethics and human rights
Guarantee equitable, inclusive access; regulate implementation to protect fundamental rights and prevent abuse or misuse; technological sovereignty

scope.note: Existing scope_note kept: a promotion bill with ethics and rights language in general terms; precedents allow inclusion of AI-titled or strategy-like instruments with some safety content. Not a duplicate of PY-01 (Senate bill, May 2025). The record rests on newspapers only (level C), as its verification note says.
